notes.title: Update: Setting Game Modes!
notes.content:
New game modes have been added, which can be enabled before playing:

Free Play: Play without winning, endlessly for as long as you want.
No Events: Disable all events, freely choose religious aspects.
No Loss: Disable atheism and its influence.

Combine these modes for a different gaming experience!

Also:
Various improvements and bug fixes!
Thank you for your feedback! Join our Discord!
